concept: Traveler's Storage: compartment tray, divider tabs, champagne metal frame, repeated lozenge/seed motifs and separate item detail card.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE high-fidelity inventory-window concept image for ProjectM, a modern fantasy HD-2D MMORPG. Landscape 16:9 composition, ideally 2048x1152 or higher. One finished screenshot-like composition, NOT a contact sheet or several alternatives.

Input image 1 is the supplied quest/chat art-direction reference: reinterpret its elegant shaped frames, warm metal trim, midpoint diamonds, little protruding headers, blue surfaces, and game-world background into the new INVENTORY design. Input image 2 is the supplied character/HUD style reference: use the readable item icons and inventory grid, modern typography and light floating layers; DO NOT copy its multi-screen sheet or character portrait. Redesign the interface completely for inventory. Neither source asset will be overwritten.

Core concept: TRAVELER'S STORAGE / adventure carrying case, abstracted as a sophisticated shallow compartment tray with a floating attached item-identification card. The silhouette must clearly suggest an organized travel container through segmented metal rim, shallow stacked tray layers, little clasp-shaped central fittings and protruding category dividers. This is a usable modern game UI; do not illustrate a literal leather backpack, wooden treasure chest, realistic physical prop, or a quest book.

Composition: a quiet softly defocused sunlit HD-2D village visible in margins. UI occupies about 80% of canvas, fully visible and centered with comfortable margin. Dominant main storage tray on left ~65%, separate narrower item-detail card right ~30%, with small deliberate offsets and a clear gap. Main tray has slightly stepped/cut silhouette, distinct narrow lid-like header, small protruding title plaque with a simple bag symbol, shallow supporting rim offset behind it. A consistent 6-column by 4-row grid of equal square compartments dominates, clean spacing and readable item silhouettes. Show 14 occupied cells (small swords, travel boots, flask potions, green crystal, feather, scroll, ring, herbs, ore), 10 empty cells. First slot selected with muted-blue fill and warm metal edge, no glowing neon. Item counts tiny and tidy at lower right of stackable items. Category tabs are protruding divider/index tabs seated along the upper edge of the tray; vary selected tab position/height subtly, no generic identical full-width rectangular button row. Small tidy sort/search controls. Bottom inset rail carries coin amount and capacity plus a compact sort button. A small symmetric clasp fitting centered on lower outer rim helps the storage metaphor without blocking content.

Right card: offset slightly lower than the tray header, shaped clipped shoulders and a narrow suspended label/tag. Selected item is a refined blue-silver sword with a small leaf/seed insignia: generous icon presentation, item name, rarity, short two-line description, two clear stats, two bottom actions. Give this card a shallow layered frame and an ivory identification LABEL only as a small accent, not a huge cream window. Maintain meaningful empty space and proper alignment.

Shared visual language: visibly BLUE soft slate navy surfaces, not black. Navy occupies most UI surface; different panel, tray-cell and tab values are obvious. Warm ivory typography, muted champagne metal trim, restrained muted-blue selection; small colorful actual item artworks are permitted. Material finish is clean high-resolution 2D graphic with subtle enamel-like navy centers. Frame has actual visible WIDTH and quiet satin/brushed champagne-metal material: a roughly 5-8px outer rim at a 1920px-wide display, narrow bright upper bevel highlight and shallow darker lower edge, clear inner inset line. Not a hairline border, not bulky medieval gold, no intense gloss. Corner thickness and continuous borders remain consistent.

Motif system: choose ONE repeated small emblem: a pointed seed/leaf inside a slim lozenge. Repeat exact related shapes at header center, side-midpoint metal joins, divider ends and selected-tab tip. Use aligned symmetric fittings and same curve/line weights, rather than random unrelated ornaments. Main frame may have longer diamond-ended join pieces; smaller controls use simplified matching ends. Pattern stays out of text areas. Detail is intentional, not bare blue boxes. Two or three shallow floating layers, subtle short shadows only.

Korean UI text, crisp and carefully spelled. Main heading "소지품"; small secondary title "여행자의 수납함". Tabs "전체", "장비", "소모품", "재료", "퀘스트". Capacity "14 / 24". Coins "12,450". Sort "정렬". Detail heading "나이아의 검", rarity "희귀 · 한손검". Description "나이아의 문양이 새겨진 검.\n여행의 첫걸음을 함께한다." Stats "공격력 +24", "치명타 확률 +3%". Actions "장착", "상세 정보". Close X upper right. Do not add other paragraphs, external annotations, device frames, watermarks or logos.

Key evaluation: before reading the text, this should feel like a travel storage interface, with an elegant crafted metal outline and disciplined repeating ornament, not the generic navy rectangle layout from a business dashboard. Item-grid usability and legibility remain paramount. No realistic leather, stitches, parchment grain, rust, large flourishes, huge magic circles, neon, rainbow rarity glows, strong perspective, 3D UI render, pixelated UI, or ornate heavy baroque carving. Final output is one cohesive INVENTORY concept only.
correction_prompt:
Refine this SINGLE inventory concept image, preserving its entire current composition, background, Korean text, all item icons, all 24 item slots and 16 occupied slots, palette, crafted champagne metal rim, lower clasp, right item card and overall dimensions. Two closely bounded UI-polish changes only:
1. Correct the bottom capacity text from "14 / 24" to exactly "16 / 24", since 16 of the 24 cells are visibly occupied. Preserve every grid item and position.
2. Refine ONLY the category-tab strip just below the heading: make the five existing categories visibly read as travel-container compartment divider TABS. Keep the same labels "전체", "장비", "소모품", "재료", "퀘스트" and positions, but use staggered projecting tab shoulders with a shallow angled/stepped top edge, clearly separate seams and small narrow seed/lozenge fittings. The selected ivory "전체" tab should visibly sit a little forward/above its neighbors with a tiny downward index tip touching the grid rail. The four other navy tabs should be quieter and sit behind that lip. There must be clear shallow layer/overlap and a divider-tab silhouette, not five same-height rectangular pushbuttons. Keep text readable, horizontal and uncropped. Do not move or resize the heading, main tray, item cells, right panel or bottom bar.
Preserve the restrained continuous metallic frame and consistent diamond/seed motif. No other additions, no extra screen, no redesign, no watermark. One final polished inventory mockup.
correction_reason: Initial generated image contained 16 occupied slots but capacity label read 14/24; corrected to 16/24 and refined category divider-tab silhouettes.

visual_qa.grid: 6 columns x 4 rows; 16 occupied cells, 8 empty; 16 / 24 label
visual_qa.frame: visible satin champagne rim with repeated midpoint diamonds and lower clasp
visual_qa.text: Korean labels and illustrative item text inspected
visual_qa.palette: navy, ivory and champagne metal with colorful item artwork
